container_evidence: the host link could not sustain a container inventory query after the acceptance run; the acceptance container itself exited 0 with no OOM as recorded by the runner

defect_found.description: fetch() forwarded the caller Accept-Encoding verbatim, so a page that asked for br, zstd, gzip could receive a br body which this path cannot decode; a working URL would then fail with "unsupported TLS response content encoding"
defect_found.why_it_matters: the parser refusing br is correct, but advertising a coding one cannot decode turns a decodable response into a hard failure

fix: Accept-Encoding is replaced with exactly gzip, deflate; duplicates collapse to one field; the header is added when the caller sent none
still_open: brotli/zstd decoding (not implemented; now avoided rather than hit)
